title: Implement vars frontmatter for variable substitution
description: Add vars: option in frontmatter for defining reusable variables. Support $VAR expansion in commands. Add built-in $TEMP, $ROOT, $CWD.

title: Implement fixtures for file setup
description: Add fixtures: option to copy files to temp directory before tests. Support source/dest paths with variable expansion.

title: Implement before/after hooks
description: Add before: and after: options for setup/teardown scripts. Run before hook once before first test, after hook once after last test.

title: Implement skip/focus test annotations
description: Parse heading annotations like skip and only. Add CLI flags --skip, --only, --focus for test filtering.

title: Separate stdout/stderr capture and assertions
description: Capture stdout and stderr separately. Add ! prefix syntax for stderr assertions, or separate stdout/stderr code blocks.

title: Fix non-portable temp directory check in features.tryscript.md
Fix hardcoded /home/user paths in test files
Tryscript Enhancements: Bug fixes and new features
description: Epic for tryscript bug fixes and enhancements based on plan-2026-01-03-tryscript-enhancements.md. Phases: 1) Critical bug fixes (bin, cwd default), 2) Variables and fixtures, 3) Test filtering and output.

title: Fix bin config to resolve binaries
description: Bug: binPath is computed in createExecutionContext() but executeCommand() ignores it. Fix: Use binPath to resolve commands or prepend to PATH.

title: Add binName option for command aliasing
description: Allow aliasing a binary path to a clean command name. Example: bin: ./dist/bin.mjs with binName: mycli lets you write mycli --help instead of full path.

title: Change cwd default to test file directory
description: Change default cwd from temp directory to test file directory (cwd: .). Add cwd: temp as opt-in for isolation. This matches mental model of run commands from here.

title: Fix pnpm tryscript: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND with experimental-strip-types
Fix [CWD]/[ROOT] pattern failures due to macOS symlink resolution
